title: [Claude] Unhandled promise rejections in Deck Apps fail silently
body:
## Problem
PR #66 (#44) routes render errors, handler errors, timer errors and module-eval errors to the Deck App Failure Screen, but an unhandled promise rejection (e.g. a `fetch` chain without a `catch`) is still swallowed. QuickJS only reports these through `JS_SetHostPromiseRejectionTracker`, which `src/core/js_runtime.c` never installs.

## Fix
Install a rejection tracker at runtime start that logs the reason and reports it through the same path as `nativeReportDeckAppError` (or just logs it, if we prefer not to fail the app on a rejection; decide and document in `CONTEXT.md`). Cover with a scenario in the harness that loads a Deck App whose effect rejects a promise.

Posted by Claude Code [claude-fable-5-1]
